data.name: Privacy.Lede
data.value: What data we collect, why we process it, and which rights you have.

data.name: Privacy.S1.Body
data.value: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is OrderSphere GmbH, Musterstraße 1, 12345 Musterstadt, Germany. Contact: support@ordersphere.dev

data.name: Privacy.S2.Title
data.value: Collection and storage of personal data

data.name: Privacy.S2.Body
data.value:
We only collect personal data that you actively provide, for example when you register, place an order or contact us.

This covers your name, email address, delivery address and payment details, as far as they are needed to process your order.

data.name: Privacy.S3.Body
data.value:
We process data

  • to perform a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR),
  • to comply with legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and
  • on the basis of legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)), for example to improve our service.

data.name: Privacy.S4.Body
data.value: We use strictly necessary cookies so the website works, for example for sign-in and the cart. See our cookie policy for details.

data.name: Privacy.S5.Body
data.value:
You have the right at any time to

  • access (Art. 15 GDPR),
  • rectification (Art. 16),
  • erasure (Art. 17),
  • restriction of processing (Art. 18),
  • data portability (Art. 20), and
  • object (Art. 21).

To exercise them, write to support@ordersphere.dev.

data.name: Privacy.S6.Body
data.value: We keep your data only as long as the purposes above require, or as long as statutory retention periods apply, for example under German commercial and tax law (HGB, AO).

data.name: Terms.Lede
data.value: The rules that apply to every order placed with OrderSphere.

data.name: Terms.S1.Body
data.value: These terms and conditions apply to all contracts concluded between OrderSphere GmbH and its customers through the online shop ordersphere.dev.

data.name: Terms.S2.Body
data.value: By clicking “Place order” you submit a binding order for the goods in your cart. The contract is concluded once we confirm your order by email or ship the goods.

data.name: Terms.S3.Body
data.value: All prices include statutory VAT. Shipping costs are shown separately during checkout.

data.name: Terms.S4.Body
data.value: We deliver to the address you provide. Delivery within Germany usually takes 2–5 business days.

data.name: Terms.S5.Body
data.value: We accept the payment methods offered during checkout.

data.name: Terms.S6.Body
data.value: Consumers have a statutory right of withdrawal of 14 days. How to withdraw is described on the returns & withdrawal page.

data.name: Terms.S8.Body
data.value: The law of the Federal Republic of Germany applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. Should individual provisions be invalid, the remainder of the contract stays in effect.

data.name: Cookies.Lede
data.value: Which cookies we set and how you control them.

data.name: Cookies.S1.Body
data.value: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website. They keep the website working and manage your session, such as sign-in and cart.

data.name: Cookies.S2.Body
data.value: <dl><dt>Strictly necessary</dt><dd>Required for sign-in, the cart and security. They cannot be switched off, because the website would not work correctly without them.</dd><dt>Statistics (optional)</dt><dd>Show us how visitors use the website so we can improve it. Only with your consent.</dd><dt>Marketing (optional)</dt><dd>Make advertising more relevant to you. Only with your consent.</dd></dl>

data.name: Cookies.S3.Body
data.value: You can withdraw your consent at any time or delete cookies in your browser. Disabling certain cookies may limit how the website works.

data.name: Faq.Lede
data.value: Answers to the most common questions about your order.

data.name: Faq.A1
data.value: Delivery within Germany usually takes 2–5 business days. Once your order ships, you receive a tracking link by email.

data.name: Faq.Q2
data.value: Which payment methods do you accept?

data.name: Faq.A2
data.value: The available payment methods are shown at checkout.

data.name: Faq.Q3
data.value: How do I cancel my order?

data.name: Faq.A3
data.value: As long as your order has not shipped, you can cancel it under “My orders”. After that, use your right of withdrawal.

data.name: Faq.Q4
data.value: What if an item arrives damaged?

data.name: Faq.A4
data.value: Email us within 14 days. We review the case and either send a free replacement or refund the purchase price.

data.name: Faq.A5
data.value: You have a 14-day right of withdrawal. The “Returns & withdrawal” page describes the steps; the return label is free.

data.name: Faq.A6
data.value: We currently ship to Germany and Austria. More countries are planned.

data.name: Faq.Q7
data.value: How do I change my details?

data.name: Faq.A7
data.value: You can update your contact details and delivery addresses in your profile at any time.

data.name: Faq.A8
data.value: Yes. All payments run over encrypted connections, and we never store full card details on our servers.

data.name: Faq.MoreBody
data.value: Write to us — we reply within 24 hours.

data.name: Contact.Lede
data.value: We're here for you — whichever way suits you best.

data.name: Contact.FormNotice
data.value: The contact form is still in preparation. Until then, email is the fastest way to reach us.

data.name: Returns.Lede
data.value: 14-day right of withdrawal. The return label is on us.

data.name: Returns.Step1.Body
data.value: Send a short email to support@ordersphere.dev with your order number and the reason for the return.

data.name: Returns.Step2.Body
data.value: Within one business day you receive a free return label. Print it and attach it to the parcel.

data.name: Returns.Step3.Body
data.value: Drop the parcel off at one of our shipping partner's branches. Keep the receipt as proof.

data.name: Returns.Step4.Body
data.value: Once the parcel arrives, we check the goods and refund the purchase price within 5 business days.

data.name: Returns.NotesBody
data.value:
• The withdrawal period is 14 days from receipt of the goods.
  • Where possible, return items in their original packaging.
  • The statutory right of withdrawal and our goodwill policy are independent of each other.
  • The full conditions are in our terms and conditions.
